init.title: Rooms and behaviour
init.description: One room per line as Name=ID, for example Kitchen=4. The easiest way to find the IDs is the Learn room service.

data_description.require_docked: Prevents starting in the middle of a running job, where the robot may lose its orientation.

clean_rooms.name: Clean rooms
clean_rooms.description: Starts cleaning the named rooms. With "Use room settings from the app" on (default), the robot switches to Customised mode and the per-room settings from the app apply. The order of the names is the cleaning order.

entry_id.name: Vacuum
entry_id.description: Only needed if several vacuums are set up.

clean_floor.name: Clean whole floor (untested)
clean_floor.description: Starts a whole-floor clean with the current global settings. The command is derived from app behaviour and has not been verified on the device.

entry_id.name: Vacuum
entry_id.description: Only needed if several vacuums are set up.

learn_room.name: Learn room
learn_room.description: Waits until you start exactly one room in the app and stores its ID under the name. Cancel or pause the run in the app afterwards.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name the room is stored under.

timeout.name: Wait time
timeout.description: How long to wait for the start in the app.

forget_room.name: Forget room

not_docked.message: The vacuum is not on its dock (state: {state}). Start aborted. The condition can be switched off in the options.

mode_timeout.message: Customised mode was not confirmed. Start aborted.

source_missing.message: The source entity for "{role}" no longer exists. Set up the integration again.

empty_name.message: The name must not be empty.

learn_timeout.message: No room was started in the app within {seconds} seconds.

learn_not_single.message: More than one room was started ({ids}). Start exactly one room to learn it.

entry_not_found.message: The given vacuum is not set up.

entry_required.message: Several vacuums are set up. Please provide entry_id.

start_not_confirmed.message: The robot did not accept the start after {attempts} attempts of {seconds} s each. The cloud confirmed the command, but the robot did not run it (for example during mop washing or battery cycle). Try again later.

job_pending.message: A cleaning job is still running or paused (status: {status}), even if the vacuum is on its dock. Start aborted. Wait until the job has finished, or end it in the app.

paused_at_base.message: The current job is paused while the vacuum is on its dock (status: {status}). Resume or end it in the app.

no_rooms.message: No rooms have been learned yet. Learn rooms first; the vacuum never starts without a room selection.

unknown_segment.message: Segment {segment} is not a learned room. Map the areas again in the vacuum entity settings.

custom_mode_with_global_settings.message: The cleaning mode is set to Customised. Choose another cleaning mode or switch on "Use room settings from the app".

fan_speed_customised.message: The cleaning mode is Customised: the robot uses the per-room settings from the app, so the global fan speed has no effect. Choose another cleaning mode first, or use the "Suction power" select.
